description: Fetch a subgraph's GraphQL schema via standard introspection. Returns types, fields, and arguments so an agent can build queries without external docs. Requires your own The Graph API key, passed as _apiKey.

_apiKey.description: Your own The Graph API key (BYO — Pipeworx does not supply one). Free 100k queries/month after signup at https://thegraph.com/studio/apikeys.

name: introspect_schema
